summary: Vocational nurse with over 25 years of clinical experience in California, progressing from staff nursing to field and home health nursing. Experienced in acute and respiratory care, including tracheotomy and ventilator-dependent patients, medication administration, IV drug therapy, wound care, and specimen and laboratory collection. Strong in patient education, care plan coordination with physicians and registered nurses, and patient advocacy, with a track record of high patient satisfaction. Has supervised certified nursing assistants and managed high-acuity caseloads of 10+ patients per shift in detox and withdrawal settings.
